You need those annotation values inside your test methods, right?
Otherwise you might want to have a look at `QuarkusTestBeforeEachCallback` as a workaround.
Yes, I need to read annotations from test methods or before each callback, but different test classes may perform different actions on a given annotation.
@antoniomacri can you check `2.2.1.Final`? It includes another fix: #19751

Ops, of course! I'll wait to see it on Maven Central

Thanks!

Fixed Before/AfterEach!

However Before/AfterAll give an exception on this line since getTestMethod is empty:

    Method newTestMethod = determineTCCLExtensionMethod(info.getTestMethod().get(), testClassFromTCCL);

You can use the example above as a reproducer.

Would you like me to open another issue?

Argh...at a certain point of that PR I had a proper handling of this case, but it got lost in subsequent iterations.

Please create another issue, I'll have a look ASAP!
